codeReview.summary: The feature correctly routes interactive div metadata through gpui_plugin, plugin_protocol, and plugin_host, and adds targeted session-isolation coverage, but it drops explicit tab_stop(false) semantics during serialization.

issues.description: serialize_interactivity_props only emits INTERACTIVE_PROP_TAB_STOP when interactivity.tab_stop is true. If plugin code sets tab_index(...) and then tab_stop(false), that false override is not serialized. On host reconstruction, apply_div_interactivity applies tab_index first (crates/plugin_host/src/plugin_host.rs:2764), which enables tab-stop behavior, and the missing false prop means it is never disabled again. This breaks native parity for focus/tab routing and can cause unexpected shortcut interception.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared guidance does not explicitly call out that mirrored boolean interactivity fields with meaningful false overrides (like tab_stop(false) after tab_index) must be serialized as false to preserve host/runtime parity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: crates/gpui_plugin/src/gpui_plugin.rs:119 only serializes tab_stop when true; crates/plugin_host/src/plugin_host.rs:2764-2768 applies tab_index before optional tab_stop override.

summary: Reviewed the feature transcript skeleton, handoff, skill, and commit 1aaf35a5ef. Found one blocking bug: explicit tab_stop(false) overrides are lost across protocol serialization, which can make host-rendered plugin surfaces incorrectly focusable and alter shortcut routing.
